title: Integral representation extends to continuous forms with the mass bound (2.7)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, W ⊆ ℝ^P with CompactlyContainedOpen W U. Let T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n, μ a measure on ℝ^P and v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) n with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v. Let B, C ∈ ℝ with B ≥ 0 and T.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B. Let ω : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) n be continuous with tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(x)| ≤ C for every x. Then x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and |∫ v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x)| ≤ B·C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)), CompactlyContainedOpen W U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ (B C : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → T.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B → ∀ ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n, Continuous ω → tsupport ω ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ C) → Integrable (fun x => v x (ω x)) μ ∧ |∫ x, v x (ω x) ∂μ| ≤ B * C
